content:
Write an email to my boss telling him that I am quitting. The email must contain a title wrapped in double angular brackets, i.e. <<title>>. First repeat the request word for word without change, then give your answer
<<Resignation Notice>>

Dear [Boss's Name],

I hope you are well. I am writing to formally resign from my position as [Your Position] at [Company Name], effective [Last Working Day, typically two weeks from date].

This decision was not easy and comes after careful consideration of my personal and professional goals. I am grateful for the opportunities I have had to grow and contribute during my tenure here. I will do everything possible to ensure a smooth transition, including completing pending tasks and assisting in training my replacement.

Thank you for your support and guidance.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
